heroTitle: Complete Outpatient Clinic & Medical Examination Management
heroSubtitle: An integrated system for outpatient clinic management covering appointment booking, patient registration, examination tracking, and billing connected to the general ledger.
heroBoxDesc: Flexible booking with auto-reminders and real-time occupancy reports.
visionTitle: How Does the Outpatient System Streamline Your Healthcare Facility?
visionDesc: The system unifies patient management, scheduling, medical examinations, and billing in one easy-to-use interface, reducing wait times and improving healthcare quality.

features.title: Patient Registration & Medical Records
features.desc: Create comprehensive patient profiles with personal data, medical history, allergies, and previous medications, linked to national ID for quick retrieval.

features.title: Appointment Scheduling & Booking
features.desc: Smart scheduling system by clinic, doctor, and specialty with patient reminders, attendance rates, and wait-time analytics.

features.title: Examination & Diagnosis Tracking
features.desc: Document visit details including symptoms, diagnosis, prescribed treatment, and required lab tests, with one-click access to visit history.

features.title: Multi-Specialty Clinic Management
features.desc: Full support for multi-specialty clinics (internal medicine, orthopedics, pediatrics, dermatology, etc.) with dedicated doctor and equipment assignments.

features.title: Outpatient Billing & Collections
features.desc: Automated billing for consultations and procedures with health insurance support, corporate discounts, and multi-channel payment linked to general ledger.

features.title: Outpatient Reports & Statistics
features.desc: Detailed reports on visits per clinic and doctor, common diagnoses, occupancy rates, average wait times, with export and print capabilities.

steps.title: Patient Registration & Booking
steps.desc: Patient registers and books an appointment at the appropriate specialty clinic.

steps.title: Examination & Diagnosis
steps.desc: Doctor examines the patient and records symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment plan.

steps.title: Lab Tests & Radiology
steps.desc: Lab tests and radiology are ordered electronically with results auto-linked to the patient file.

steps.title: Billing & Follow-up
steps.desc: Invoice is issued, follow-up is scheduled, and the medical report is shared with the patient.

closingTitle: Ready to Upgrade Your Outpatient Clinic Operations?
closingDesc: Speak with our healthcare ERP advisors today and schedule a live walkthrough of the Outpatient Clinics module.
